# wirral.ai

> Let us automate the boring tasks so you can focus on the fun stuff. wirral.ai
> uses AI to increase efficiency and decrease workload for UK businesses:
> assistants that answer and book enquiries by chat and voice, admin that runs
> itself, and social content written in the business's own voice.

Based in Widnes, in the North West of England, working on site across Wirral,
Liverpool, Manchester, Chester, Warrington and North Wales, and remotely
UK-wide. More than forty organisations supported.

## Positioning

wirral.ai takes repetitive work off small and medium businesses. It finds the
jobs that eat the most hours each week and hands them to AI, built around the
tools the business already uses, with a person kept in the loop wherever it
matters. Every piece of work is priced and agreed before it starts.

## What wirral.ai automates

- **AI assistants**: chat and voice assistants on a business's website,
  trained on its services, prices and FAQs, that qualify enquiries and book
  calls into WhatsApp or a calendar, saving every lead with full details.
- **Admin automation**: connecting systems so data stops being retyped, and
  automating quotes, confirmations, reminders, follow ups and reports.
- **Content and marketing**: social posts, campaigns and monthly calendars in
  the business's own voice, scheduled across channels.
- **Websites and training**: fast, AI ready websites with the assistant built
  in, plus plain English training so teams are confident with what is set up.

## Worked example: Content Hub

[Content Hub](https://socialapp.wirral.ai) is wirral.ai's own app and an example
of what it builds for clients. It learns a business and its voice, interviews
the owner for real stories, and writes and schedules posts for Facebook,
Instagram, LinkedIn, TikTok, X, YouTube Shorts and Google. Free to start;
Starter is £9 a month, Pro £19 a month (both with a 14 day free trial, no card),
and Done for you, where the wirral.ai team runs the content, is £149 a month.

## Getting in touch

WhatsApp, or message +44 7368 349702 on WhatsApp directly.

## Our work

- [Portfolio](https://www.wirral.ai/work) — live websites and platforms built by wirral.ai, with screenshots refreshed weekly.
- [The Order Block case study](https://www.wirral.ai/work/the-order-block) — an AI coached trading education platform: an AI coach that interviews traders about each trade, a deterministic rules engine that reads real GBPUSD prices every day, and a learning loop that shares lessons from reviewed trades. Live at [theorderblock.app](https://theorderblock.app).

## How engagements work

Five stages: understand, plan, implement, educate, improve. Not every
organisation needs all five. The opening conversation is free. Work is scoped as
a defined first piece with a fixed price agreed before anything starts. No
hourly billing, no open-ended retainers, no published price list.

## Who it suits

SMEs and established mid-sized organisations, typically from a handful of people
up to a few hundred, across retail, clinical, hospitality, trades, membership and
professional services.
